name: Váckisújfalu (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated stripe of red and blue triangles along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Váckisújfalu: a red, white and blue shield with bars, a black bird, ears of grain and a ploughshare.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
